name: tagguards
description: `request.tag` validation, per rule and at the capacity boundary. Carried because this guard had FOUR hand-written copies — the worker, the sim prelude, the arena's epilogue, each restating the same rules — and they had already drifted on the refusal MESSAGE for the tag cap, which a handler can catch and read. Presence checks cannot see that; only running the rule on both engines can.
